id./param/scenario/cs/c_090_cs_020.pack|cs_:
"Sssss... They were less useful than I'd thought.
  Just a warm-up act, it seems.

"Sssss... By the evil god's power, I was revived.
  Far stronger than before!

"Now it's easy to control the hearts of
  fighters steeped in the desire for strength
  and make them my servants.

"But Vince, your heart has no such desire,
  so I can't control you...
  Reformed by the Luminary. Infuriating!

"I meant to rule you too, as my vanguard,
  and dominate this town with
  the fighters' violence and fear!

"I will never allow that!!
  {var:1}! Let's take him down!
  Help me protect Octagonia!!

"Sssss... Silence, Vince.
  A weakling like you is no match for me.

"Luminary {var:1}!
  Carve into your body my new power,
  granted by the evil god!!
